title: Fire Walker
body:
A mod that adds 2 new enchantments to the game:

Fire Walker: Functions like Frost Walker but for lava, replacing it with magma. You gain fire resistance when walking on the magma and gain a speed boost. Doesn't work with Frost Walker or Depth Strider.

Flame Walker: Spawns fire on whatever block you run on, doesn't work while sprint jumping, and gives you fire resistance as well.
